name: Corvin Deboeser
headline: Engineering @ OpenAI
summary:
I’m always keen to explore new ways to utilize data and AI, partner with visionary builders/founders, and collaborate with innovative teams to ship products that push boundaries and empower improve lives.

With experience across software engineering, data science, and production management, I've developed a passion for creating high-impact solutions at the intersection of data, user experience, and AI. Over the past few years, I’ve built and deployed AI platforms in various industries including telco, med tech, and financial services, always focusing on how cutting-edge technology — like GenAI and Agentic AI — can deliver real-world value. Along the way, I’ve helped build and scale engineering teams in both startup and corporate environments, not only ensuring organizations gain a tangible tech advantage, but also focusing on the individual growth of my mentees in the process.

What truly drives me is building products that make a positive difference in people’s lives. Whether mentoring junior engineers or leading cross-functional teams, I love blending technical expertise with a forward-thinking business perspective.

positions.title: External Innovation Consultant
positions.description: This project aimed at identifying new and innovative moon-shot business concepts. The main focus for those endeavours was to create ideas how to create and sustain healthy habits, especially targeting change resistant people. Intersected into three phases, the project started with discovering and analysing trends and current developments in various relevant fields, such as in technology, society and regarding political and legal regulations. Afterwards, we identified and analyzed the main drivers behind those trends. The most significant drivers then build the foundation for describing future scenarios. In the final stage, we built business concept based on the identified trends and the elaborated future scenarios. The project was part of the Technology Management curriculum at the CDTM. It was conducted by a group of 25 students whereas we exchanged team members were after each phase to maximize interdisciplinarity and diversity.

company.name: OpenAI
company.tagline: Creating safe AGI that benefits all of humanity.
company.description:
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core. OpenAI is dedicated to putting that alignment of interests first — ahead of profit.

To achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. Our investment in diversity, equity, and inclusion is ongoing, executed through a wide range of initiatives, and championed and supported by leadership.

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
